description: This stacked bar chart from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision" illustrates the average performance of two methods, "Standard" (gray) and "Ours" (blue), across two different baselines: "Base" and "CORC". The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance", is scaled linearly from 48 to 62, with tick marks at 2-unit intervals. The horizontal axis presents the two baseline categories, "Base" and "CORC", in left-to-right order. For the "Base" category, a single blue bar reaches a value of approximately 59. For the "CORC" category, the bar is stacked, with the gray "Standard" portion reaching approximately 51 and the blue "Ours" portion extending to approximately 59, resulting in a total height of 59. The chart does not show any sorting of bars by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color and stacking.
